source(allowSchemaDrift: true,

typeProperties.script:
section Section1;
shared p_schoolcompliance_s = let AdfDoc = AzureStorage.DataLakeContents("https://growecdstorage.dfs.core.windows.net/giraffe/parquet/p_schoolcompliance_s.parquet"), Parquet = Parquet.Document(AdfDoc) in Parquet;
shared UserQuery = let  
    Source = #"p_schoolcompliance_s",  
    // Select required columns FIRST (better performance)  
    #"Selected Columns" =  
        Table.SelectColumns(Source,{  
            "amount",  
            "id",  
            "registration_checklist",  
            "dsd_application_submission_date",  
            "dsd_grant_approved",  
            "is_dsd_grant_paid",  
            "dsd_status",  
            "effective_date",  
            "is_eligible_for_other_subsidy",  
            "expiry_date",  
            "grow_franchisee_commencement_date",  
            "is_npo_registered",  
            "npo_registration_date",  
            "npo_registration_number",  
            "number_of_childrens_registration",  
            "other_subsidy_end_date",  
            "other_subsidy_start_date",  
            "school_id",  
            "school_capacity"  
        }),  
  
    // Replace nulls (text + numeric in ONE step)  
    #"Replace Nulls" =  
        Table.TransformColumns(  
            #"Selected Columns",  
            {  
                {"npo_registration_number", each if _ = null then "" else _},  
                {"dsd_grant_approved", each if _ = null then "" else _},
                {"registration_checklist", each if _ = null then "" else _},  
                {"amount", each if _ = null then 0 else _},  
                {"school_capacity", each if _ = null then 0 else _},  
                {"school_id", each if _ = null then 0 else _},  
                {"number_of_childrens_registration", each if _ = null then 0 else _}  
            }  
        ),  
  
    // Transform DSD Status + Boolean fields in ONE step  
    #"Transform Fields" =  
        Table.TransformColumns(  
            #"Replace Nulls",  
            {  
                // Option set mapping  
                {"dsd_status", each  
                    if _ = "Registered" then "301220002"  
                    else if _ = "Gold/Full registration" then "301220006"  
                    else if _ = "Bronze registration" then "301220007"  
                    else if _ = "Expired" then "301220000"  
                    else if _ = "Application Submitted" then "301220001"  
                    else if _ = "Application Denied" then "301220005"  
                    else if _ = "Not Registered" then "301220003"  
                    else if _ = "Conditionally Registered" then "301220004"
                    else if _ = "Silver/Conditional registration" then "301220004"  
                    else _  
                },  
  
                // Yes/No → true/false directly (skip 0/1 conversion completely)  
                {"is_dsd_grant_paid", each if Text.Lower(Text.From(_)) = "yes" then true else false, type logical},  
                {"dsd_grant_approved", each if Text.Lower(Text.From(_)) = "yes" then true else false, type logical}  
            }  
        ),  
  
    // Rename at the END (cleaner pipeline)  
    #"Renamed Columns" =  
        Table.RenameColumns(#"Transform Fields",{  
            {"amount", "tcbgrow_amount"},  
            {"id", "tcbgrow_appid"},  
            {"registration_checklist", "tcbgrow_checklistholder"},  
            {"dsd_application_submission_date", "tcbgrow_dsdapplicationsubmissiondate"},  
            {"dsd_grant_approved", "tcbgrow_dsdgrantapproval"},  
            {"is_dsd_grant_paid", "tcbgrow_dsdgrantpaid"},  
            {"dsd_status", "tcbgrow_dsdstatus"},  
            {"effective_date", "tcbgrow_effectivedate"},  
            {"is_eligible_for_other_subsidy", "tcbgrow_eligibleforotherstudy"},  
            {"expiry_date", "tcbgrow_expirydate"},  
            {"grow_franchisee_commencement_date", "tcbgrow_franchisecommencementdate"},  
            {"is_npo_registered", "tcbgrow_nporegistered"},  
            {"npo_registration_date", "tcbgrow_nporegistrationdate"},  
            {"npo_registration_number", "tcbgrow_nporegistrationnumber"},  
            {"number_of_childrens_registration", "tcbgrow_numberofchildrensregistration"},  
            {"other_subsidy_end_date", "tcbgrow_othersubsidyenddate"},  
            {"other_subsidy_start_date", "tcbgrow_othersubsidystartdate"},  
            {"school_id", "tcbgrow_school"},  
            {"school_capacity", "tcbgrow_schoolcapacity"}  
        }),  
  
    // Final datatype adjustments  
    #"Changed Column Types" =  
        Table.TransformColumnTypes(#"Renamed Columns",{  
            {"tcbgrow_eligibleforotherstudy", type text},  
            {"tcbgrow_nporegistered", type text},
            {"tcbgrow_dsdgrantapproval", type text},
            {"tcbgrow_dsdgrantpaid", type text}  
        })  
  
in  
    #"Changed Column Types";
